decision_question: Based on this resume alone, would I spend 45 minutes interviewing this person for this role?
verdict_rationale: The bike share survey (R23, R24) and the weekly sales numbers (R13) are real analyst work. SQL (J12) shows up only as a class, and the internship bullets (R11, R12) describe duties.
one_line_take: The survey project and the Excel work earn a call; SQL beyond a class is the open question.

dimension_scores.note: Excel shown in work; SQL only from a class.
A real survey with 140 responses and a recommendation.
Duties more than results in the internship.
Steady job plus an internship while studying.

findings.title: SQL is required but only shows up as a class
findings.detail: The posting asks for SQL experience. I see it in your coursework and skills list, but no line shows you using it, so I cannot tell how far you got.

evidence.quote: Experience with SQL and Microsoft Excel

fix.suggestion: If a class project used SQL, describe it in one line with what you queried.
